what: A board of screen-height sections stacked vertically moves up one section at a time over 1.2s power2.out on one wheel notch, a 60px vertical swipe, or the up/down keys (no document scroll). The white band hanging below each section starts after 10% progress and chases −100% by 6% each frame, sweeping up faster than the section and washing the screen white at the moment of transition. After the entering section settles, its text lines rise from 100% below over 1.1s power2.out (.5s per step), and .4s later fx:sweep is fired at the band to redraw it — a brand story that turns one photo and one sentence at a time

options.dur: Section transition length (seconds), default 1.2 — shorten for screens that are flipped often
options.ease: Four curve values, default 0.45,0,0.55,1 (power2.out if omitted)
options.lag: Progress share where the band starts following, default .1
options.follow: Share the band follows per frame, default .06 (original on phone .2)
options.rise: Duration the text line rises (s), default 1.1
options.delay: Delay (seconds) for firing fx:sweep on the entered section’s band, default .4
options.lock: Time (ms) to block reverse input while turning, default 500
options.--fx-height · --fx-band-peek: Panel and section height (default 100svh), height of the band visible in the section (default 22.3vw)
options.[data-fx-part=track] · [data-fx-part=pag: Vertical strips and sections inside the panel
options.[data-fx-part=band]: White strip straddling the bottom of the section (optional) — adding feather-mask-sweep too (start: manual) makes it redraw from the left
options.[data-fx-part=line] data-step: Text lines that rise (optional) — inside a parent that hides overflow (overflow: hidden)
options.fx:page · fx:goto: Event the panel fires when advancing (detail.index) — fire it on the panel to jump to that section = number)
